stem: Two healthy cannabis plants are 28 days from emergence but show different node counts and internode patterns. What is the best first documentation step?
choices: Record each plant's chronology and observed morphology separately before proposing a cause
Assign both plants the same developmental stage because they are the same age
Classify the taller plant as light-stressed without collecting additional evidence
Use the cultivar name to decide which architecture is normal
rationale: Chronology and morphology are different observations. Cannabis developmental morphology varies with genotype and conditions, so the record should preserve both before causal interpretation.
